records.title: Idea Visual: Intent-Driven View Synthesis for Smart Mobile Devices via Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion Models
records.reason: The work concerns mobile-device view synthesis with diffusion, not LLM inference systems.

records.title: TaCo: Tasks Co-Programming for Accelerating Inference in Scaling Edge Computing
records.reason: IEEE Xplore access required JavaScript/bot verification; exact DOI/publisher full text was not retrievable. Search/author metadata describes cooperative task programming for edge inference, but full method and evaluation remain unavailable.

records.title: Reaping the Fruits of LLM Pruning: Towards Small Language Models for Efficient Non-Coding Variant Effect Prediction
records.reason: The study applies layer-wise pruning to genomic language models and evaluates non-coding variant-effect prediction; reduced DNABERT-2 models retain near-SOTA task performance with fewer than half the parameters, while technical constraints prevented testing the strongest baseline. The application is specialized encoder genomics, so general LLM inference transfer remains uncertain.

records.title: OmniSVG: A Unified Scalable Vector Graphics Generation Model
records.reason: OmniSVG is a scalable autoregressive SVG generation model; the paper evaluates vector-generation quality and scaling. KV-cache appears as a related lineage, but no new KV-cache compression or LLM-serving mechanism is demonstrated.

records.title: MEMORYLLM: Towards Self-Updatable Large Language Models
records.reason: MEMORYLLM adds persistent memory for self-updatable LLMs and evaluates memory-augmented language tasks. The memory is a learned knowledge/update mechanism rather than inference-memory reduction or offload; no systems efficiency improvement is shown.
